title: DiscoveredCapabilities
summary: Statically known capabilities of a discovered route module.

sections.title: Fields
sections.body: loader and action tell the browser to proxy those handlers to the server; clientAction, meta, shouldRevalidate and ErrorBoundary are present before the module loads; dataEndpoint selects a legacy data endpoint. The build derives these from the route's exports.
sections.code: const capabilities: DiscoveredCapabilities = { loader: true, meta: true };
